question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is: **told.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"told"** means to communicate information to someone in spoken or written form. (बताया)

 
 
• **Example: **He told me about his plans for the weekend.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that exams are being administered in many Goa schools, and they have been instructed to move up the date.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill the blank is **"told"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Asking** (पूछना): To request information or an answer from someone.

 
 
• **Example:** He is asking for directions to the station.
 
 
 
• **Said** (कहा): Express something in words.
 
 
• **Example:** She said she would be late.
 
 
 
• **Tell** (बताना): To give information to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** Please tell me the truth.
